features.label: Broad upright bear build with rounded ears and large paws
features.notes: Full visible figure has a stocky brown bear shape, round ears, thick limbs, and broad feet.

features.label: Two rounded ears with lighter tan inner areas
features.notes: Both round ears are visible above and beside the head.
features.requiredColorRelation: tan inner areas contrast with brown outer ears

features.label: Expressive face with dark eyes and brows, tan muzzle, black nose, and open smile
features.notes: The centered face has arched dark brows, round eyes, a dark nose, and a smiling mouth with a visible tongue.

features.label: Large oval tan belly patch
features.notes: A broad, pale tan patch covers most of the front torso.
features.requiredColorRelation: tan patch contrasts with surrounding brown fur

features.label: Bright red scarf wrapped around the neck
features.notes: The scarf forms a wide red band below the head.
features.requiredColorRelation: red scarf contrasts with brown fur

features.label: Dark brown diagonal satchel strap with a small gold buckle
features.notes: The strap crosses the torso diagonally; its small rectangular buckle is visible on the viewer-left side of the belly.
features.requiredColorRelation: gold buckle contrasts with the dark brown strap

features.label: Brown satchel pouch with a round gold button
features.notes: A rounded pouch hangs at the character's viewer-right hip.
features.requiredColorRelation: gold button contrasts with the brown pouch
